title: Compatible condensed-point comparison data
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, $\ell$ a prime and $E$ a finite intermediate coefficient field in $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the point $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], the finite-subextension-valued condensed ring and its pullback to $s$ [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], its bounded constructible derived category $\mathcal D_s$ [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible, def-sfb-dc-tensor], the coefficient inclusion [def-sfb-subfield-to-qlbar-coefficient-map], and $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$ [def-weil-point-fd-complexes]. Define a finite frame as a cochain complex with a specified finite basis in each degree whose ranks have finite support. Define the comparison data as the following dependent record, with the same choices shared in all its fields.

The realization record gives inherited monoidal and triangulated structures, an additive exact strong braided functor $\rho:D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)\to\mathcal D_s$, its shift comparison, and symmetry involutivity. The scalar record gives constant multiplication on the condensed regular module and its pullback, the ring identification of point sections with $\Omega$, the finite-subfield scalar action and compatibility with its coefficient map, and an injective ring map $\epsilon:E\to\operatorname{End}(1_{\mathcal D_s})$ equal to the degree-zero derived image of the pulled-back multiplication.

The matrix record assigns to each frame $F$ a complex of internal modules, degreewise isomorphisms to the finite biproducts of the regular module, scalar matrices for differentials and all chain maps, and comparison isomorphisms with $\rho(QF)$ commuting with all chain maps. It includes membership of $QF$ in the source and inversion of quasi-isomorphisms. A tensor-model record assigns chain isomorphisms between the total tensor of these models and the model of any framed tensor representative. The tensor matrix proposition prescribes their entries by the two source basis labels and the source tensor isomorphism. The tensor descent proposition equates their derived image to the tensor constraints of $Q$ and $\rho$, using these same model identifications.

The cohomology record gives source membership of degree-zero cohomology, isomorphisms between the degree-zero target cohomology and its realization, and an $\Omega$-linear isomorphism between geometric-point evaluation and $\Omega\otimes_E H^i(C)$. The duality record gives source membership of the derived internal dual, the exact pairing of its realization with $\rho(C)$ with the canonical displayed evaluation, transport of both pairing maps along isomorphisms, and the categorical trace formula [sk-d-trace] with the alternating cohomology traces [def-weil-endomorphism-trace] and scalar map $\epsilon$. It also records trace one for the identity of the unit. The full comparison record consists of these five records, the tensor-model record and the two tensor propositions. These are types of data and properties; their definitions assert no existence of an inhabitant.
